entries.en: fixed, sure and certain; firm, steadfast
entries.notes: R栏空缺，M栏首末音节声调污損難辨（T99）且定字多读难以逐音对应；据L栏firme cossa segura与H栏定互证为固定确实之义。

entries.en: firm, solid, secure
firm, solid, hard
settled, secure; at ease
entries.notes: R栏空缺，M栏第三音节声调污損難辨（T99）；据H栏安与L栏firme cossa互证为安定安稳之义。

entries.en: to consent, grant, allow; true, trustworthy
firm, solid; firmly
settled and orderly, at peace, well-arranged
entries.notes: R栏空缺，M栏第二音节声调污損難辨（T99）；据H栏安貼与L栏firme cossa互证为安帖安稳之义。

entries.en: proper, fitting; well-grounded, reliable
settled and due; certainly, surely
solid, firm, sturdy
steadfast, resolute, firm
firmness, steadfastness
entries.notes: R栏空缺，M栏声调污損難辨（T99）；据H栏定与L栏Firmeça互证为坚定稳固之义。

entries.zh: 刚烈、坚毅（于善事上坚定）；猛烈
entries.en: staunch, ardent, firm in what is good; fierce

entries.zh: 定见、明确的见解；主见坚定
entries.en: settled opinion, firm view; firmness of purpose
entries.notes: L栏enlosſintentta字迹难辨，推断为en los intentos（意向/主意）；据H栏定見与M栏têng guienn互证为定见之义。

entries.zh: 定度、定准；行事坚定有度
entries.en: fixed measure, settled rule; firmness in doing
entries.notes: R栏空缺，M栏声调多处污損難辨（T99）且en haur残段难以对应；据H栏定度与L栏firmeça en fazer互证为行事坚定之义。

entries.zh: 定著、安定确实；有定力、拿定主意
entries.en: settled, fixed; to have firmness, stand resolute
entries.notes: R栏空缺，M栏声调污損難辨（T99）且simat la残段难以对应；据H栏定著与L栏tener firmeça互证。

entries.en: to nail, fasten; nail
entries.notes: H栏字形作鐙（本义马镫），据L栏fixar~clavar与M栏Tēng推断此处当为釘（钉）之义，依赖推断故降中等。

entries.en: to stick in, insert; to plant into the ground
entries.notes: R栏空缺，M栏声调污損難辨（T99）且H栏字形存疑（疑:挿/插）；据L栏fixar en el suelo与M栏cha判为插立之义。

entries.en: to post up, affix edicts or placards; to publish
entries.notes: R栏空缺，M栏两音节声调均污損難辨（T99）；据H栏揭与L栏fixar edittos, o rotulos互证为张贴揭示之义。

entries.zh: 糊告示、张贴告示（官府布告公文）
entries.en: to paste up public notices, edicts or mandates
entries.notes: R栏空缺，M栏三音节声调均污損難辨（T99）；据H栏糊告示与L栏fixar edittos, o mandatos互证为张贴布告之义。
